NICE Guideline CG150: Headaches in Over 12s Diagnosis and Management | Publisher: National
Medication-Overuse Headache Prevention
Frequent use of acute pain medications can cause medication-overuse
headache. Prevention Advice: - Track pain medication frequency in a
headache diary. - Consult a doctor if acute treatments are needed more
than twice a week.
